newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovaks to mandate IBJ to manage $120 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Slovaks to mandate IBJ to manage $120 mln loan.

text.p: Slovakia is preparing to sign a mandate agreement with Industrial Bank of Japan (IBJ) to manage a $120 million loan, a Finance Ministry official told Reuters on Wednesday.

Ministry spokeswoman, Zuzana Brutenicova, also said the government planned to draw an ECU 25 million credit from the European Investment Bank (EIB). "Agreements on these two loans should be signed sometime around the end of July," she said.
Funds from the two credits should help cover planned infrastructure investment, mainly motorway construction, Brutenicova added.
Neither she nor other ministry officials would provide further details on the two credits.
The Finance Ministry said earlier on Wednesday that the government was expected to decide next Tuesday on whether to launch a $250 million Eurobond or draw an international loan of equivalent sum.

Funds from the planned bond issue, or an international loan, should also partialy cover investment for infrastructure projects and help boost the basic capital of the planned Slovak Export-Import bank.
